mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video_stats_consumed_event( event_id, vid, aggregate_sequence, event_type, delta, payload_hash, process_status, consumed_at ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{vid}, #{aggregateSequence}, #{eventType}, #{delta}, #{payloadHash}, 0, NOW(3) )
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id, vid, aggregate_sequence, event_type, delta, payload_hash, process_status, last_error, consumed_at, committed_at FROM video_stats_consumed_event WHERE event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.update: UPDATE video_stats_consumed_event SET process_status = 1, committed_at = NOW(3), last_error = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND process_status != 1
